profile.headline: President at Awymedia
profile.jobTitle: President, Web Developer, and Business Analyst
profile.summary: I look forward to take a challenging role as a Web Developer, and provide effective solutions that will help your organization increase productivity and achieve growth.

positions.title: President, Web Developer, and Business Analyst
positions.description:
•	Design, develop, build and manage the company website, which attracts hundreds of subscribers, exceeding monthly goals.
•	Negotiate contracts with our marketing partners to reduce our marketing costs by 20%.
•	Plan and implement sales activities for lead generation, doubling our conversion rate..
•	Review business processes to acquire the right technology that makes the organization perform better and become more efficient.
•	Gather business requirements by conducting detailed interviews with business users.
•	Convert business requirements into functional specifications, and design Data Flow Diagrams (DFDs), Entity Relationship Diagrams (ERDs), and web page mock ups to streamline processes.
•       Work with SQL queries for data manipulations, and prepare analysis and reporting services.

positions.title: Inside Sales Accounts Manager
positions.locationName: Fort Lauderdale, Florida, United States · On-site
positions.description:
•	Followed quotation process flow from initial receipt of quotation until quote was submitted to the customer.
•	Strictly met customer deadlines related to the quotation.
•	Responsible for receiving and reviewing files provided by customer.
•	Liaised with purchasing team and colleagues and vendors in India and Mexico for the collection of outside quotations, NPD progress, issues, raw material statuses, and deadlines.
•	Ensured outside quotations were clear, concise, and accurate for the process of customer’s quotation.
•	Accomplished account growth by building a trusting relationship with customers and solving problems.
•	Created a database for all pending and completed quotations for oversite and follow up.
•	Monitored the supply chain process, from building tools to raw material sourcing, to shipping finished goods.
•	Managed multiple projects for multiple accounts with forecasted sales of more than $2 million.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
•	Create website layout/user interface by using standard HTML/CSS practices.
•	Integrate data from various back-end services and databases.
•	Gather and refine specifications and requirements based on technical needs.
•	Create and maintain software documentation.
•	Be responsible for maintaining, expanding, and scaling our site.
•	Stay plugged into emerging technologies/industry trends and apply them into operations and activities.
•	Cooperate with web designers to match visual design intent.
•	Implementing back-end code, vendor integrations, and app/plugin development for X Cart.
•	Translating static mockups into working interactive experiences.
•	Creating user-friendly web pages and developing new user-facing and mobile-based features.
•	Building reusable code and libraries for future use.
•	Maintain websites backend and front end.

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
• Designed, developed, and built promotions & renewals (landing pages, order forms, email abandon series) in coordination with our marketing team, using best design practices for all devices that increased sales.
• Designed, customized, and built lead gen efforts (websites, microsites, banners, databases, bots, triggered mailings) integrated with analytics tools that increased our customer base.
• Provided support, maintenance, and helped track and fix bugs in an efficient manner.

positions.title: Web Programmer
positions.description:
•	Developed detailed analysis applications that tracked user activity grouped by a variety of options. These applications dramatically improved the quality of the subscriber base by also analyzing CPA and co-registration campaigns based on the performance of the subscribers.
•	Redesigned and developed the company website which increased customer retention by 50% and page views by 80%.
•	Assisted in development of a custom Content Management System and Admin. panel for the website and email campaigns.
•	Created carousel ads for partners that run in iframes using HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, JQuery, PHP, and MSSQL.

positions.title: Web Developer and Graphic Designer
positions.description:
•	Designed product promotions, product catalogs, brochures, emails, and product images for website.
•	Created engaging web pages, and a Content Management System that increased traffic to our website by 30%.
•	Improved customer relations with a CRM system using PHP and MySQL.
•	Identified potential network security issues and installed appropriate software that eliminated previous threats.

positions.title: Assistant Manager
positions.description:
•	Managed business operations, and our store performance level increased with respect to the previous 3 months.
•	Involved in product management, including ordering, receiving, returns, and price changes.
•	Handled unusual circumstances, and situations that included problem solving.
•	Maintained and improved personnel and store performance levels with the previous quarter.

positions.title: PHP Developer Internship
positions.description:
• Worked with the team on advancing the company's applications, back office and web sites with PHP 5.
• Created, produced, tested, implemented, and maintained the company's Database Management System to create new leads with MySQL 5.
• Built interactive applications with PHP 5 and MySQL 5 to attract new customers.

educations.schoolName: Florida International University - College of Business

projects.title: Event Memories
projects.description: Event memories is my opportunity to give people a movie of a specific event in their lives they can watch and cherish with the ones they love.
